faqs.question: How does this online Python compiler work?
faqs.answer: This online Python compiler runs directly in your browser using client-side WebAssembly technology (Pyodide). Your Python 3 code executes locally inside your browser without sending your code to any remote server.

faqs.question: Which Python version is supported?
faqs.answer: The compiler supports Python 3.11+ syntax, including async/await, f-strings, match-case statements, type hinting, and popular standard modules (math, random, json, re, datetime, collections).

faqs.question: Can I take user input (input()) in Python?
faqs.answer: Yes, interactive input prompts and mock standard input (stdin) parameters are fully supported for terminal and command-line style programs.

faqs.question: Is this Python compiler completely free?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is 100% free with unlimited executions, zero subscriptions, and no registration or sign-up required.
